address_hint: 中正路（忠義路至西門路）
tagline_zh: 昭和年代的「台南銀座」與林百貨
tagline_en: 1930s "Tainan Ginza" anchored by Hayashi Department Store
story_zh: 末廣町是日治時期台南市中心，1932年完工的林百貨與同年興建的連棟店鋪住宅讓中正路成為「台南銀座」，林百貨更是南台灣第一家百貨公司，頂樓還有神社與當年稀有的電梯。戰後一度沒落，林百貨2014年修復重開，帶動街區重新成為逛街熱點。
story_en: Suehirocho was the heart of Japanese-era Tainan; the 1932 Hayashi Department Store—southern Taiwan's first, with a rooftop shrine and a rare lift—and matching shophouse rows turned Zhongzheng Road into "Tainan Ginza". After decades of decline, Hayashi reopened in 2014 and revived the street.
getting_there: 台南火車站搭公車至林百貨，或步行約20分鐘
best_time: 林百貨營業時間內，夜間立面打燈

image.commons_file: Hayasi Department Store at the intersection of Jhongjheng Road and Jhongyi Road.jpg

tagline_zh: 誤傳裝了大砲的小北門古街
tagline_en: A gate street named after a cannon that wasn't
story_zh: 大銃街位於清代府城小北門內，是經小北門進出府城的要道。相傳官府在城門安置小型槍砲，居民誤以為是大砲，便稱此街為「大銃街」。附近有明鄭時期創建的開基天后宮與荷蘭時期鑿的烏鬼井，北區公所近年整合鎮北坊歷史街道。
story_en: Inside Tainan's Little North Gate, this was a main route into the walled city. Legend says officials mounted small guns on the gate, which residents took for a big cannon ("da chong"). Nearby are the Kaiji Tianhou Temple from the Koxinga era and the Dutch-period Wugui Well.
getting_there: 台南火車站步行約15分鐘
best_time: 可串連總爺街、開基天后宮

tagline_zh: 清代總爺營署旁的保存老街
tagline_en: A well-kept Qing lane beside the old garrison commander's office
story_zh: 總爺街原名過坑仔街，屬府城鎮北坊，因清代北路營參將（俗稱「總爺」）署設在附近而改名。街道蜿蜒保持舊時紋理，是台南市保存較完整的老街之一，至今仍是安靜的住宅巷弄。
story_en: Originally "Crossing-the-Ditch Street" in the Zhenbei ward, it was renamed after the nearby office of a Qing garrison commander (zongye). Its curving alignment survives intact, making it one of Tainan's better-preserved old lanes, though it remains purely residential.
getting_there: 台南火車站步行約15分鐘

tagline_zh: 海邊三百年聚落的彩繪巷弄
tagline_en: Murals in a 300-year-old seaside village
story_zh: 喜樹是台南南區靠海的三百年聚落，地名相傳因土壤鹽分高樹木難長、取諧音「喜樹」而來。萬皇宮的「龜醮」是延續百年的民俗祭儀；近年社區以彩繪妝點巷弄，成為彩繪文創聚落，傍晚可順遊黃金海岸看夕陽。
story_en: Xishu is a 300-year-old coastal village in south Tainan whose salty soil supposedly gave the name. Its Wanhuang Temple keeps a century-old "turtle offering" rite, and recent community murals have turned the lanes into a photo spot, close to Golden Coast sunsets.
getting_there: 台南火車站搭公車至喜樹；建議騎車或開車
best_time: 傍晚順遊黃金海岸

tagline_zh: 糖業城鎮的戲院與百貨行記憶
tagline_en: Memories of cinemas and shops in a sugar town
story_zh: 新營因日治時期設立鹽水港製糖會社新營工場而興起，中山路、延平路一帶曾是戲院與百貨行雲集的商圈。如今多數街屋已改建，僅零星保留舊立面，在地團體以「漫步日常新營街」等導覽活動重述往日風華。
story_en: Xinying boomed with its Japanese-era sugar refinery, and the Zhongshan/Yanping Road area once bustled with cinemas and department stores. Most shophouses have since been rebuilt, leaving scattered old facades that local groups now interpret through walking tours.
getting_there: 台鐵新營車站步行約10分鐘

tagline_zh: 急水溪畔清代官道渡口的小聚落
tagline_en: A Qing highway crossing village on the Jishui River
story_zh: 鐵線橋位於急水溪畔，清代縱貫官道在此過溪，聚落因渡口與橋樑而形成，舊屬「鐵線橋堡」。聚落中心的通濟宮供奉媽祖，是地方信仰中心。如今是安靜的農村聚落，老街痕跡有限。
story_en: Tiexianqiao grew at the point where the Qing north–south highway crossed the Jishui River, and gave its name to a Qing administrative district. Its Tongji Temple, dedicated to Mazu, remains the village centre; today it is a quiet farming settlement with few old-street traces.
getting_there: 建議開車或騎車（新營市區南方約4公里）

address_hint: 菁寮里（菁寮聖十字架天主堂周邊）
tagline_zh: 《無米樂》的稻米老街
tagline_en: The rice-country street made famous by "Let It Be"
story_zh: 菁寮是嘉南平原上的稻作聚落，老街在清末至日治時期因集散稻米而繁盛，留有木造街屋、老藥房與打鐵店。2005年紀錄片《無米樂》以此地稻農為主角，讓菁寮聲名大噪；附近由德國建築師設計的聖十字架天主堂也是建築迷必訪之地。
story_en: Jingliao grew as a rice-trading hamlet on the Chianan Plain, keeping wooden shophouses, an old herbal pharmacy and smithy. The 2005 documentary "Let It Be" about its rice farmers made it famous, and the nearby Holy Cross Church by German architect Gottfried Böhm draws architecture fans.
getting_there: 台鐵後壁站轉乘公車或騎車約10分鐘
best_time: 稻穗金黃的6月、11月前後

tagline_zh: 興隆橋南的清代港街，如今寧靜悠閒
tagline_en: A Qing port street south of Xinglong Bridge, now hushed
story_zh: 橋南老街因位於興隆橋之南而得名，清光緒初年建成，臨近鹽水舊港而店鋪行郊林立，是鹽水通往南部鄉鎮的要道。隨著港口淤積沒落，老街轉為住宅區，但仍保留閩式街屋與木造店面，是鹽水最有古味的一段。
story_en: Named for its location south of Xinglong Bridge, this street was built in the early Guangxu era and thrived on Yanshui's river port as a route south. As the harbour silted up it became residential, but it still keeps some of Yanshui's most atmospheric Minnan and timber shopfronts.
getting_there: 台鐵新營站轉乘公車至鹽水
best_time: 元宵節鹽水蜂炮期間

address_hint: 中正路、中山路、三福路一帶（中境里）
tagline_zh: 「一府二鹿三艋舺四月津」的蜂炮古港
tagline_en: The old port of "Yuejin", home of fireworks and yi-mein
story_zh: 鹽水舊稱「月津」，清代是倒風內海旁的重要港口，有「一府二鹿三艋舺四月津」之稱。日治時期街面改正，二層樓店鋪取代低矮街屋，至今仍可見數棟昭和式商店。每年元宵的鹽水蜂炮與道地的鹽水意麵，讓小鎮聲名遠播。
story_en: Known as Yuejin, Yanshui was one of Qing Taiwan's top ports ("first Tainan, second Lukang, third Mengjia, fourth Yuejin"). Japanese-era street reforms replaced low houses with two-storey shops, several of which survive. The town is famous for its Lantern Festival beehive fireworks and its springy yi-mein noodles.
getting_there: 台鐵新營站轉乘公車至鹽水
best_time: 元宵節蜂炮（需防護裝備）

address_hint: 興中路（頂街）、中山路、中正路（下街）
tagline_zh: 招牌後的巴洛克街屋與麻豆碗粿
tagline_en: Baroque shophouses behind the signboards, and famous rice cakes
story_zh: 麻豆老街並非單一街道，而是從頂街興中路延伸到下街中山路、中正路的街廓，多建於1920年代至昭和年間，是麻豆巴洛克街屋最集中的區域。1938年落成的電姬戲院是代表建築；老街新舊交雜、許多立面被招牌遮住，需要抬頭細看。
story_en: Madou's old street is a district rather than one road, running from upper Xingzhong Road to lower Zhongshan/Zhongzheng Roads, with Baroque shophouses from the 1920s–30s. The 1938 Dianji Theatre is its landmark; many facades hide behind signboards, so look up. Madou wanguo rice cakes and pomelos are the local fame.
getting_there: 台南火車站或隆田站轉乘公車至麻豆
best_time: 中秋前文旦產季

tagline_zh: 蕭壠香科與剪黏廟宇旁的大正街屋
tagline_en: Taisho-era facades beside the Jintang Temple
story_zh: 佳里舊名蕭壠，是西拉雅族蕭壠社故地。中山路自日治大正時期發展，仍可見多棟巴洛克風立面；金唐殿創建於1698年，以葉王交趾陶與剪黏聞名，三年一科的蕭壠香科是台南五大香科之一。對面的中山市場則有在地早餐與漁貨。
story_en: Jiali, formerly Siaolang, was a Siraya village site. Zhongshan Road developed in the Taisho era and keeps several Baroque-style facades; Jintang Temple (founded 1698) is renowned for Koji pottery and cut-porcelain work, and its triennial Siaolang pilgrimage is one of Tainan's five great processions.
getting_there: 台南火車站搭公車至佳里
best_time: 早上逛中山市場；蕭壠香科年份

tagline_zh: 以刈香聞名的西港仔街
tagline_en: The market town of the famous Xigang pilgrimage
story_zh: 西港仔街是西港的中心聚落，昔日為濱海民番貿易的據點。慶安宮三年一科的「西港刈香」聞名全國，被列為國家重要民俗；但市街經道路拓寬後舊建築已不多，平日只是一般鄉鎮街道。
story_en: Xigang village was once a coastal trading post between Han settlers and indigenous people. Its Qing'an Temple hosts the nationally listed triennial Xigang pilgrimage, but road widening removed most old buildings, leaving an ordinary town street outside festival years.
getting_there: 台南火車站搭公車至西港
best_time: 西港刈香年份（農曆四月）

address_hint: 中山路（保安路口至中華路口）
tagline_zh: 慶安宮兩側的昭和騎樓街
tagline_en: Showa-era arcades flanking Qing'an Temple
story_zh: 善化老街位於中山路，全長約400公尺，以古蹟慶安宮為中心向兩側發展。建築多建於1930年代，屬昭和初期的騎樓街屋，但隨工商發展，半數以上已翻修，只剩部分立面可見舊貌。
story_en: Shanhua's 400 m old street on Zhongshan Road spreads either side of the historic Qing'an Temple. Its arcaded shophouses mostly date from the 1930s, but more than half have been rebuilt, leaving only some original facades.
getting_there: 台鐵善化站步行約10分鐘

address_hint: 中正路（中山路至信義路）
tagline_zh: 南瀛第一的巴洛克牌樓街屋
tagline_en: Tainan County's finest Baroque facades
story_zh: 新化舊稱大目降，昔日是山區農產的集貨驛站。中正路老街屋建於1920年代，前後兩期相隔約17年，呈現兩種巴洛克立面風格，曾獲選南瀛十大歷史建築第一名；另一條中山路老街則在1995年拓寬時被拆除。
story_en: Xinhua, formerly Tavokan, was a collection depot for hill-country produce. The Zhongzheng Road shophouses, built in two phases about 17 years apart in the 1920s–30s, show two generations of Baroque facades and were voted the region's top historic architecture; a second old street on Zhongshan Road was demolished in 1995.
getting_there: 台南火車站搭公車至新化
best_time: 週末上午搭配新化老街市集

address_hint: 中正路、中山路交會一帶
tagline_zh: 賣涼水的小店口，長成白河市街
tagline_en: A town grown from a roadside drink stall
story_zh: 白河舊稱「店仔口」，相傳源自二百多年前吳姓商人在山產與農產交易處開的涼水小店。地方人士嫌名稱不雅，後依白水溪改名白河。此地位處斷層帶，百年來屢經地震重建，老街建築已所剩無幾，夏季蓮花季是最熱鬧的時候。
story_en: Baihe was once "Dianzaikou" (at the shop's door), said to come from a cold-drink stall where hill and farm produce was traded 200 years ago. Sitting on fault lines, the town has been rebuilt after several earthquakes, so little old architecture remains; summer lotus season is its busiest time.
getting_there: 台鐵新營站轉乘公車至白河
best_time: 6–8月蓮花季

tagline_zh: 泥漿溫泉的日治溫泉鄉老街
tagline_en: A Japanese-era hot-spring village of mud baths
story_zh: 關子嶺溫泉在日治時期被開發為療養地，與北投、陽明山、四重溪並稱台灣四大溫泉，以灰黑色的泥漿溫泉聞名。山坡上的老街與階梯「好漢坡」串連旅館與商店，雖不如往昔熱鬧，但甕缸雞與溫泉仍吸引遊客上山。
story_en: Developed as a spa by the Japanese, Guanziling is one of Taiwan's four classic hot springs and famous for its grey mud baths. Its hillside street and stepped lanes link inns and shops; quieter than its heyday, it still draws visitors for clay-jar roast chicken and the springs.
getting_there: 台鐵新營站搭黃10公車至關子嶺
best_time: 冬季泡湯

tagline_zh: 山間清幽的日式木造房老街
tagline_en: A tranquil hill-village street of timber houses
story_zh: 東原位於東山區山區，老街上留有不少日式木造老房子與老雜貨行，氛圍比一般觀光老街清幽。每年農曆二月東山碧軒寺「佛祖媽」巡遊十八重溪流域時會經過東原，是聚落最熱鬧的時刻；可搭配東山咖啡與龍眼乾產區同遊。
story_en: In the hills of Dongshan District, Dongyuan keeps Japanese-style timber houses and old grocery stores, far calmer than typical tourist streets. Its liveliest moment is the annual Buddha-Mother procession through the Eighteen Creeks area; it pairs well with Dongshan's coffee and dried-longan farms.
getting_there: 建議開車（台南市區約1小時）
best_time: 農曆二月佛祖媽巡遊

tagline_zh: 芒果一條街，噍吧哖事件的故鄉
tagline_en: Mango Street, in the town of the Tapani Incident
story_zh: 玉井舊稱噍吧哖，1915年在此發生日治時期最大規模的武裝抗日事件「噍吧哖事件」。今日以愛文芒果聞名，中正路被稱為「芒果一條街」，產季時連藥局、服飾店都在賣芒果；北極殿前仍有一排日治後期街屋。
story_en: Yujing, formerly Tapani, saw the 1915 Tapani Incident, the largest armed uprising against Japanese rule. Today it is Taiwan's mango capital: in season nearly every shop on Zhongzheng Road—pharmacies included—sells mangoes, and a row of late Japanese-era shophouses faces the Beiji Temple.
getting_there: 台南火車站搭綠幹線公車至玉井
best_time: 6–8月芒果產季

tagline_zh: 約400公尺的田園寫實彩繪老街
tagline_en: A 400 m village lane of realistic rural murals
story_zh: 北寮老街位於關廟區新光里，社區發展協會自2010年前後推動彩繪，由一位廚師兼業餘畫家利用週末創作，在約400公尺的老街上畫滿田園風光、水墨與人物動物。彩繪起初是為整理環境、防止小黑蚊孳生，意外成為拍照景點。
story_en: In Guanmiao's Xinguang village, a community project from around 2010 saw a chef-turned-weekend-painter cover some 400 m of old lane with realistic rural scenes and animals. Started to tidy the village and fight biting midges, it became an unexpected photo spot.
getting_there: 建議開車或騎車
best_time: 白天光線佳時拍照

address_hint: 中山路、新中路（奉天宮周邊）
tagline_zh: 笨港媽祖遷來的新港，與香甜的新港飴
tagline_en: Mazu temple town famed for its peanut "Xingang candy"
story_zh: 1803年笨港溪氾濫，部分居民帶著媽祖神像遷到麻園寮，建立新港並創奉天宮，成為台灣媽祖信仰重鎮。廟前市街以進香客為客源，發展出新港飴等糕餅老店，大甲媽祖遶境也以奉天宮為終點。
story_en: After floods ravaged Bengang in 1803, residents carried their Mazu statue to Mayuanliao and founded Xingang and Fengtian Temple, now a major Mazu centre and the terminus of the Dajia Mazu pilgrimage. The temple-front streets serve pilgrims with old confectioners, notably the peanut-maltose "Xingang candy".
getting_there: 嘉義火車站或嘉義高鐵站搭公車至新港
best_time: 農曆三月大甲媽祖遶境期間

tagline_zh: 孔廟前泮宮坊下的文創步行街
tagline_en: A pedestrian craft street facing Tainan's Confucius Temple
story_zh: 府中街位於台南孔廟對面，入口立有清代泮宮石坊，清代因跨枋溪有木橋而稱「枋橋頭」。街道經整治為徒步街後，老屋陸續進駐文創小店、冰品與小吃，假日遊客如織，是遊孔廟時最順路的散步街。
story_en: Opposite Tainan's Confucius Temple, entered under the Qing-era Pan Palace stone arch, Fuzhong Street was once "Plank Bridge Head" for its wooden bridge over the Fang Creek. Pedestrianised, its old houses now host craft shops, ice desserts and snacks, making it a busy weekend stroll.
getting_there: 台南火車站步行約20分鐘，或搭公車至孔廟
best_time: 平日上午較清幽

tagline_zh: 渡輪下船即到，媽祖廟前吃海產
tagline_en: Step off the ferry onto Kaohsiung's oldest street, lined with seafood stalls
story_zh: 旗津是打狗最早有漢人定居的地方，相傳清康熙年間漁民在此集資建媽祖宮，廟前街道因此被稱為「打狗第一街」。1860年代打狗開港後，旗後一帶成為洋行與貿易重鎮。1990年道路拓寬後老屋所剩不多，如今廟前路以海產店、小吃與觀光人潮為主。
story_en: Cijin is where Han settlers first put down roots in Takao; fishermen pooled money to build a Mazu temple here in the Kangxi era, and the street before it became known as 'Takao's first street'. After Takao opened as a treaty port in the 1860s, the area hosted trading houses. Road widening in 1990 removed most old buildings, and today Miaoqian Road is all seafood restaurants, snacks and weekend crowds.
getting_there: 捷運西子灣站或鹽埕埔站轉步行至鼓山渡輪站，搭渡輪至旗津站下船即達
best_time: 平日傍晚可順看西子灣夕陽；假日人潮多

tagline_zh: 昔日高雄銀座，越戰美軍的酒吧街
tagline_en: Once Kaohsiung's Ginza, later the bar street of Vietnam-era US sailors
story_zh: 鹽埕一帶在日治時期由鹽田填海造陸而成，1915年設鹽埕町，此街成為最繁華的商業街，人稱「高雄銀座」。戰後1960至70年代越戰期間，美軍艦隊停靠高雄港，七賢三路酒吧林立，成為著名的「酒吧街」。1992年道路拓寬後舊建築所剩無幾，如今只剩少數招牌與記憶。
story_en: Yancheng was reclaimed from salt pans in the Japanese era; after Shioe-chō was created in 1915 this became the city's busiest shopping street, the 'Ginza of Kaohsiung'. During the Vietnam War US navy ships docked in Kaohsiung and Qixian 3rd Road filled with bars, earning the nickname 'Bar Street'. Road widening in 1992 removed most old buildings; today only scattered signs and memories remain.
getting_there: 捷運鹽埕埔站步行約5分鐘
best_time: 可結合鹽埕老街區、駁二藝術特區一起逛

address_hint: 新樂街、大仁路、五福四路、大溝頂一帶
tagline_zh: 高雄最早的鬧區，舶來品與老牌小吃
tagline_en: Kaohsiung's original downtown of smuggled goods and decades-old food stalls
story_zh: 鹽埕是高雄最早的市中心，日治時期市役所、商社都在附近。戰後因港口之便，堀江商場以販售船員帶回的舶來品聞名，大溝頂則是加蓋在排水溝上的商場，新樂街則以金飾、布料店林立。隨市中心東移而沒落，近年因駁二藝術特區與老店美食重新吸引年輕人。
story_en: Yancheng was Kaohsiung's first downtown, home to the Japanese-era city hall and trading companies. After the war, Horie Market became famous for foreign goods brought ashore by sailors, Dagouding was a market built over a covered drainage canal, and Xinle Street filled with gold and fabric shops. It declined as the city centre moved east, but the Pier-2 art district and old-school eateries have brought young visitors back.
getting_there: 捷運鹽埕埔站即達
best_time: 中午至傍晚，多數小吃店晚上較早打烊

address_hint: 捷興二街、鼓波街、臨海三路一帶
tagline_zh: 日治高雄的發源地，走讀港口與鐵道
tagline_en: Birthplace of modern Kaohsiung, where the port railway began
story_zh: 哈瑪星是日治初期浚港填出的新生地，名稱來自日語「濱線」——通往碼頭與魚市的鐵道線。這裡曾是高雄的政經中心，郡役所、街役場、高雄第一代火車站都設在此。戰後政經重心東移，但留下許多日式街屋，近年因居民發起保存運動而重新受到重視。
story_en: Hamasen is land reclaimed when the port was dredged in the early Japanese era; its name comes from the Japanese 'hama-sen', the beach railway lines to the docks and fish market. It was once Kaohsiung's political and economic centre, home to the district office and the first Takao Station. When the centre moved east many Japanese-era shophouses survived, and a resident-led preservation movement has revived interest.
getting_there: 捷運西子灣站或輕軌哈瑪星站步行即達
best_time: 傍晚到西子灣看夕陽，晚上代天宮廟口有小吃

address_hint: 內惟地區舊聚落（近內惟國小、李氏宗祠一帶）
tagline_zh: 柴山腳下的老聚落，市場與廟宇
tagline_en: An old settlement at the foot of Mt. Chai, with markets and temples
story_zh: 內惟是柴山腳下的古老聚落，清代已有漢人與平埔族在此開墾，李姓宗族是重要的開庄家族。日治時期鄰近設立台灣第一座水泥廠，帶動工業與人口。如今老街以傳統市場與住家為主，少有觀光設施，2022年啟用的內惟藝術中心為社區帶來新的訪客。
story_en: Neiwei is an old settlement below Mt. Chai, cleared by Han settlers and Pingpu people in the Qing era, with the Li clan among its founders. Taiwan's first cement plant was built nearby in the Japanese era, bringing industry and residents. Today the old street is mostly a traditional market and homes; the Neiwei Arts Center, opened in 2022, draws some new visitors.
getting_there: 輕軌美術館站或內惟藝術中心站步行約10分鐘
best_time: 上午市場時段較有生活感

address_hint: 三鳳中街（建國三路以北、鐵路以南）
tagline_zh: 北迪化、南中街，年節採買南北貨
tagline_en: The south's answer to Dihua Street — dried goods and New Year shopping
story_zh: 三鳳中街橫穿三塊厝聚落中央，是南北雜貨批發商聚集的街道，有「北迪化、南中街」之稱。每年農曆年前一個月至除夕變身年貨大街，人潮洶湧、媒體爭相報導。1990年代起受大賣場衝擊，商家成立商圈促進會翻修街道，並在入口立起七彩浴火鳳凰地標。
story_en: Sanfong Central Street runs through the old Sankuaicuo settlement and is lined with dried-goods wholesalers, earning the saying 'Dihua in the north, Zhongjie in the south'. In the month before Lunar New Year it becomes a packed festive market. Hit by hypermarkets from the 1990s, merchants formed an association, renovated the street and put up a rainbow phoenix gateway.
getting_there: 台鐵三塊厝站或捷運後驛站步行約5分鐘
best_time: 農曆年前一個月最熱鬧

address_hint: 三民路一帶（近鳳山第一公有市場）
tagline_zh: 鳳山縣城最早的商街，兵仔市旁巷弄
tagline_en: The oldest commercial lane of Fengshan county town
story_zh: 鳳山在清代嘉慶、道光年間成為鳳山縣治（舊稱埤頭街），三民路一帶舊稱「草店仔」，是縣城早期的商業街。附近的第一公有市場因軍人眷屬採買而有「兵仔市」之稱。如今舊建築多已改建，主要為市場與住家，可結合雙慈殿、龍山寺等古蹟走讀。
story_en: Fengshan became the county seat (then called Pitou Street) in the early 19th century, and the Sanmin Road area, once known as Caodianzai, was among its earliest trading lanes. The nearby First Public Market, popular with military families, is nicknamed the 'soldiers' market'. Most old buildings have been rebuilt; it is best combined with nearby temples on a walking tour.
getting_there: 捷運鳳山站步行約10分鐘
best_time: 上午市場時段

tagline_zh: 短巷裡叮噹作響的傳統打鐵舖
tagline_en: A short lane where traditional blacksmiths still hammer away
story_zh: 鳳山過去是農業與軍事重鎮，對農具與刀具需求大，打鐵業者聚集在三民路旁的小巷，短短幾十公尺曾開設十四家打鐵店。隨著機械化與進口刀具興起，如今只剩三、四家仍在營業，成為難得還能看到傳統打鐵的地方。
story_en: Fengshan's farms and garrisons needed tools and blades, so blacksmiths clustered in a lane off Sanmin Road — at its peak fourteen forges operated within a few dozen metres. Mechanisation and imported tools have left only three or four still working, making it one of the few places to watch traditional smithing.
getting_there: 捷運鳳山站步行約10分鐘
best_time: 白天店家開工時

address_hint: 埤仔頭街、店仔頂路一帶
tagline_zh: 鳳山舊城旁的清代聚落街
tagline_en: A Qing-era settlement street beside the old Fengshan county wall
story_zh: 埤仔頭是左營舊城外的清代聚落，鳳山縣舊城是台灣第一座土城（1722年），後改建為石城。縣治遷往鳳山後，此地被稱為「舊城」，聚落街道也逐漸沒落。如今舊建築多已改建，主要可看的是舊城城牆與城隍廟。
story_en: Pizitou is a Qing settlement outside the old Fengshan county wall in Zuoying — Taiwan's first earthen city wall (1722), later rebuilt in stone. After the county seat moved to Fengshan, the area became known as the 'old city' and its streets declined. Most old buildings are rebuilt; the city wall and City God temple are the main sights.
getting_there: 台鐵左營（舊城）站步行約10分鐘
best_time: 可搭配蓮池潭、見城館一起走

address_hint: 左營下路（元帝路至孔營路間保留舊貌）
tagline_zh: 左營舊聚落的老幹道，保留一段舊貌
tagline_en: The old main road of Zuoying village, with one section untouched
story_zh: 左營下路早年是左營舊聚落的主要幹道，後因左營大路開通而失去地位。近年道路拓寬時，元帝路至孔營路之間保留了原本狹窄的舊貌，另在旁邊新闢左營新路。這段路以住家和小廟為主，適合順遊蓮池潭時散步。
story_en: Zuoying Xia Road was the main road of old Zuoying village until Zuoying Avenue took over. When it was widened, the stretch between Yuandi Road and Kongying Road was kept at its old narrow width and a new road was built alongside. It is mainly homes and small temples, a pleasant stroll from Lotus Pond.
getting_there: 台鐵左營（舊城）站步行約15分鐘

image.commons_file: 舊城國小後曾家古建物.JPG

tagline_zh: 海軍眷村旁的軍品與西服街
tagline_en: Navy-town street of military gear and tailors
story_zh: 西陵街緊鄰左營海軍軍區，戰後隨海軍與眷村發展出特殊的商業生態，有上海街、西服街、軍品街等暱稱。這裡曾聚集許多來自上海的裁縫師傅為軍官訂製西服與制服，至今仍可找到軍品店與老裁縫店。
story_en: Xiling Street sits next to the Zuoying naval base, and after the war it developed a trade serving sailors and military families, earning nicknames like Shanghai Street, Suit Street and Military-Goods Street. Tailors who came from Shanghai made uniforms and suits for officers, and some military-supply shops and tailors remain.
getting_there: 台鐵左營（舊城）站步行約15分鐘
best_time: 白天店家營業時

address_hint: 楠梓天后宮周邊舊街區
tagline_zh: 古官道上的楠仔坑街，天后宮後巷
tagline_en: A stop on the old Qing highway, around the Mazu temple
story_zh: 楠梓舊稱楠仔坑，位於鳳山、旗山、岡山之間，清代從縣城往府城的官道必經此地。市定古蹟楠梓天后宮已有二百多年歷史，廟後仍留有舊街屋，可看出清代廟宇與街巷的發展關係。如今為一般生活街區，觀光設施不多。
story_en: Nanzi, formerly Nanzaikeng, lay where the Qing highway from the county seat to Tainan passed between Fengshan, Qishan and Gangshan. The Nanzi Mazu Temple, a municipal monument over 200 years old, still has old shophouses behind it showing how lanes grew around the temple. Today it is an ordinary residential and market area.
getting_there: 台鐵楠梓站步行約10分鐘

address_hint: 橋頭火車站周邊、中正路一帶
tagline_zh: 糖廠小鎮的老街，台灣民主第一街
tagline_en: A sugar-mill town street, once called Taiwan's first democracy street
story_zh: 橋仔頭街因1901年台灣第一座新式製糖工場橋仔頭糖廠設立而興盛，日治時期經市區改正，出現仿巴洛克立面街屋。1979年黨外人士在此發起戰後第一次政治遊行，被稱為「台灣民主第一街」。2009年道路拓寬後舊建築所剩不多，如今為黃昏市場與生活街區。
story_en: Qiaotou flourished after Taiwan's first modern sugar mill opened here in 1901, and Japanese-era street reforms added faux-Baroque shophouse facades. In 1979 opposition activists held the first post-war political march here, so it is called 'Taiwan's first democracy street'. Road widening in 2009 removed most old buildings; it is now an evening market and local shopping street.
getting_there: 台鐵橋頭站或捷運橋頭火車站步行約5分鐘
best_time: 可順遊橋頭糖廠

tagline_zh: 大社三奶壇廟前的小老街
tagline_en: A small old street by Dashe's Sannaitan temple
story_zh: 大社的三奶壇得名於供奉臨水夫人的三奶壇碧雲宮，據記載清初便已存在。周邊的三民路、翠屏路形成聚落街道，清代鳳山八景之一的「翠屏夕照」即在附近。現今多為一般住家，舊建築零星，資料相當有限。
story_en: Sannaitan in Dashe takes its name from the Biyun Temple dedicated to Lady Linshui, recorded as early as the early Qing. The settlement grew along Sanmin and Cuiping roads, near the 'Cuiping sunset', one of the Qing-era eight views of Fengshan. Today it is mostly ordinary housing with only scattered old buildings, and little has been written about it.
getting_there: 建議開車

landmarks: 原頂林仔邊警察官吏派出所
tagline_zh: 早市與百年派出所的小鎮老街
tagline_en: A small-town morning market street with a 1898 police station
story_zh: 林園舊稱林仔邊，1920年市街改正時北岸聚落改名為林園。福興街上的「原頂林仔邊警察官吏派出所」設立於1898年，是林園最早的派出所，現為市定古蹟並作為歷史教室開放。街上早上有熱鬧早市，對面巷內曾有林園最早的戲院「林園座」。
story_en: Linyuan was once called Linzaibian, renamed during the 1920 street reforms. On Fuxing Street the Dinglinzaibian police station of 1898, the area's first, is now a municipal monument open as a history classroom. The street hosts a busy morning market, and the lane opposite once held Linyuan's first cinema, the Linyuan-za.
getting_there: 建議開車，或高雄客運至林園站
best_time: 上午早市時段，午後店家多收攤

tagline_zh: 廢墟網美點安樂樓所在的街
tagline_en: Home of the photogenic ruined Anle Building
story_zh: 林園北路是日治市街改正後形成的「新街」，相對於福興街舊街。街上最知名的是洋樓廢墟「安樂樓」，因電視劇《一把青》取景而成為熱門拍照點。其餘多為一般店家與住宅。
story_en: Linyuan North Road is the 'new street' laid out after Japanese-era street reforms, in contrast to old Fuxing Street. Its best-known sight is the ruined Western-style Anle Building, which became a photo spot after appearing in the TV drama 'A Touch of Green'. The rest is ordinary shops and homes.
getting_there: 建議開車
best_time: 安樂樓為私人產權，請在外圍拍攝

address_hint: 維仁路、開元街、平和路一帶
tagline_zh: 岡山三寶的老市街，早市熱鬧
tagline_en: Morning-market streets of Gangshan's 'three treasures'
story_zh: 岡山舊稱阿公店，清代即為南北往來的市集，傳統「籃仔會」交易市集延續百年。老街以維仁路、開元街一帶為主，以生活用品與早市為主，周邊有知名的羊肉店。岡山以羊肉、豆瓣醬、蜂蜜「三寶」聞名。
story_en: Gangshan, once called A-kong-tiam, has been a market town on the north-south route since the Qing, and its traditional basket fair has run for over a century. The old streets around Weiren Road and Kaiyuan Street sell daily goods and host a morning market, with famous mutton restaurants nearby. Gangshan is known for its 'three treasures': mutton, bean paste and honey.
getting_there: 捷運岡山站或台鐵岡山站，轉乘或步行約15分鐘
best_time: 上午早市時段

tagline_zh: 香蕉王國的巴洛克老街與石拱亭仔腳
tagline_en: Banana-kingdom town of Baroque facades and stone arcades
story_zh: 旗山舊稱蕃薯寮，日治時期因香蕉外銷日本而繁榮，有「香蕉王國」之稱。中山路為日治開闢的「本通」，留有巴洛克立面街屋與罕見的石拱圈亭仔腳，皆為歷史建築。旗山車站是糖業鐵道的車站，香蕉產業沒落後，老街以香蕉蛋糕、枝仔冰等小吃轉型觀光。
story_en: Qishan, formerly Fanshuliao, boomed in the Japanese era exporting bananas to Japan, earning the title 'Banana Kingdom'. Zhongshan Road, laid out as the main street then, keeps Baroque shophouse facades and a rare stone-arch arcade, both listed historic buildings. The quaint station served the sugar railway; when the banana trade faded the street reinvented itself with banana cakes and ice pops.
getting_there: 高雄客運由高鐵左營站或高雄車站至旗山站，步行即達
best_time: 假日較熱鬧，可結合美濃一日遊

address_hint: 永安路（敬字亭至東門樓）
tagline_zh: 客家伙房、東門樓與粄條，美濃最老的街
tagline_en: Meinong's oldest street of Hakka courtyards, gate tower and rice noodles
story_zh: 1736年客家先民渡過美濃溪開庄，永安路便是美濃最早的街道，西起敬字亭、東至東門樓，全長約2公里。沿途有百年伙房、伯公壇與敬字亭，展現客家人敬惜字紙、重視文教的傳統。東門樓曾在乙未戰爭中毀於日軍砲火，1937年重建。
story_en: Hakka pioneers crossed the Meinong River and founded the settlement in 1736, and Yong'an Road was its first street, running about 2 km from the paper-burning pagoda to the East Gate. Along it are century-old Hakka courtyard homes, earth-god shrines and the pagoda where written paper was respectfully burned. The East Gate was shelled by Japanese troops in 1895 and rebuilt in 1937.
getting_there: 高雄客運由旗山轉乘至美濃站，步行約10分鐘；建議騎單車
best_time: 正月初八、初九字紙祭期間；秋冬有花海

tagline_zh: 山城老街，保存完整的日式旅社
tagline_en: A mountain-town street with a rare intact Japanese inn
story_zh: 六龜地名一說來自山形如龜，另一說是平埔族語「Lakuri」的音譯，日治時期因林業與山區開發成為交通樞紐。華南街上的「池田屋」是日式旅社，榻榻米、壁櫥等內部設施保存完整，在台灣相當少見；洪稇源商號也是當年風光的老商號。如今街上僅剩少數老店，以蓮霧等水果聞名。
story_en: Liugui's name is said to come from turtle-shaped hills or from the Pingpu word 'Lakuri'. In the Japanese era forestry and mountain development made it a transport hub. On Huanan Street the Ikedaya inn keeps its tatami rooms and closets remarkably intact, and the Hong Kunyuan store recalls prosperous days. Only a few old shops remain; the area is known for wax apples.
getting_there: 建議開車；或高雄客運由旗山轉乘
best_time: 1月蓮霧盛產期

tagline_zh: 雙慈宮廟口的扁食一條街
tagline_en: The wonton street by Shuangci Temple
story_zh: 里港舊稱阿里港，清代因位於下淡水溪畔，是屏東平原北部的河港與市集。媽祖信仰中心雙慈宮內保存多塊清代石碑，記錄建廟與當年政令。廟口與老街底林立扁食小吃店，許多店家彼此有親戚關係，使里港扁食聞名全台。
story_en: Ligang, once A-li-kang, was a Qing-era river port and market on the Lower Danshui River in northern Pingtung. Shuangci Temple, the local Mazu centre, holds several Qing stone steles recording its history and old decrees. The temple front and street end are packed with wonton shops, many run by related families, making Ligang wontons famous nationwide.
getting_there: 建議開車；屏東客運至里港站
best_time: 中午用餐時段

tagline_zh: 內埔鄉間的客家聚落小街
tagline_en: A small Hakka village street in rural Neipu
story_zh: 豐田位於六堆之一後堆的內埔鄉，是客家聚落的舊街。目前可查資料極少，僅知保有部分客家伙房建築，以住家為主，並非觀光街道。
story_en: Fengtian is an old Hakka village street in Neipu, part of the 'Rear Camp' of the Liudui Hakka settlements. Very little has been documented; it retains a few Hakka courtyard houses and is mainly residential rather than a tourist street.
getting_there: 建議開車

image.commons_file: 內埔鄉新北勢三山國王廟.jpg

address_hint: 陽濟路、東城路一帶（內埔天后宮對面）
tagline_zh: 燈籠與彩繪妝點的百年客家巷弄
tagline_en: Century-old Hakka lanes with lanterns and painted walls
story_zh: 陽濟院老街是內埔百年聚落，名稱相傳來自先民在此圈地養羊。巷弄保存客家伙房、洗石子洋風立面，近年加上燈籠與客家彩繪。附近的昌黎祠是全台唯一主祀韓愈的廟宇，可與天后宮一併參訪。
story_en: Yangjiyuan is a century-old quarter of Neipu, its name said to come from settlers who kept goats here. The lanes keep Hakka courtyard homes and Western-style terrazzo facades, recently decorated with lanterns and Hakka murals. The nearby Changli Temple is Taiwan's only temple dedicated mainly to Han Yu.
getting_there: 建議開車；或台鐵竹田站轉乘
best_time: 可搭配昌黎祠、天后宮

tagline_zh: 竹田客家村落的彩繪小街
tagline_en: A painted lane in a Hakka village of Zhutian
story_zh: 二崙是竹田鄉的客家聚落，近年社區以彩繪牆面妝點街道，與鄰近美崙村一樣成為彩繪村。可查資料有限，規模小，以住家為主。
story_en: Erlun is a Hakka village in Zhutian whose community has painted murals along its lanes, like neighbouring Meilun. Little is documented; it is small and mainly residential.
getting_there: 台鐵竹田站騎單車約15分鐘；建議開車

tagline_zh: 老夫子漫畫畫滿牆的客家村
tagline_en: A Hakka village painted with Old Master Q comics
story_zh: 美崙村牆面繪滿老夫子漫畫人物，由電影看板畫師廖長生父子執筆，並獲第二代作者王澤授權——王澤是屏東女婿，岳母就住在美崙村。村內安靜樸實，可搭配竹田驛園、客家文物館騎單車遊覽。
story_en: Meilun's walls are covered with Old Master Q comic characters, painted by film-poster artist Liao Chang-sheng and his son with permission from the comic's second-generation author Wang Tse, whose mother-in-law lives in the village. It is quiet and rustic, best combined with Zhutian Station and the Hakka museum by bike.
getting_there: 台鐵竹田站騎單車約10分鐘

tagline_zh: 竹田北邊的客家聚落小街
tagline_en: A quiet Hakka village street in northern Zhutian
story_zh: 頭崙是竹田鄉的客家聚落之一，保有零星伙房與舊街屋。公開資料極少，屬生活型街道，不適合專程前往。
story_en: Toulun is one of Zhutian's Hakka villages with a few courtyard homes and old shophouses. Very little is documented; it is an everyday village street not worth a special trip.
getting_there: 建議開車

tagline_zh: 台灣第一個指定保存的客家聚落
tagline_en: Taiwan's first protected Hakka settlement, built around springs
story_zh: 五溝水是台灣第一個依《文化資產保存法》登錄保存的客家聚落，因地下伏流豐富、湧泉水圳環繞而得名。聚落內有雕飾華麗的劉氏宗祠與眾多伙房，西盛路一帶為聚落的老街。這裡沒有熱鬧商店，適合慢步欣賞客家建築與水景。
story_en: Wugoushui was the first Hakka settlement in Taiwan designated for protection under the Cultural Heritage Act, named for the springs and channels fed by underground water. Its ornate Liu Ancestral Hall and many courtyard homes surround Xisheng Road, the village's old street. There are few shops; it is for slow walks among Hakka architecture and water.
getting_there: 建議開車；或台鐵潮州站轉乘

address_hint: 萬丹路一段（萬惠宮周邊）
tagline_zh: 紅豆故鄉，媽祖廟前吃紅豆餅
tagline_en: Red bean capital — red bean cakes by the Mazu temple
story_zh: 萬丹是台灣紅豆的主要產地，有「紅豆故鄉」之稱。老街圍繞清乾隆年間建的媽祖廟萬惠宮，地方仕紳曾以媽祖祭祀組織凝聚閩庄意識。街上的芳美商號是李家古厝，交趾陶與木雕精美，曾因產權紛爭險遭拆除，被縣府公告暫定古蹟。
story_en: Wandan grows much of Taiwan's red beans and calls itself their hometown. The old street wraps around Wanhui Temple, a Mazu temple from the Qianlong era whose worship organisation helped bind the Hokkien community. The Fangmei store, the Li family's old mansion with fine koji pottery and woodcarving, was nearly demolished in an ownership dispute before being declared a provisional monument.
getting_there: 建議開車；屏東客運至萬丹站
best_time: 冬季紅豆收成期

tagline_zh: 潮州最老商街，百年紅磚摸乳巷
tagline_en: Chaozhou's oldest trading street and its narrow red-brick alley
story_zh: 建基路是潮州最老的商街，日治時期是重要商業聚落，萬巒等地居民進城都會經過，後來以傢俱店聞名。街屋保留前店後倉、屋身狹長的格局，街上還有兩側百年紅磚牆夾成的窄巷，2010年被命名為「摸乳巷」。近年居民與團隊辦「春潮集」等活動嘗試讓老街再生。
story_en: Jianji Road is Chaozhou's oldest commercial street, a key Japanese-era trading hub that villagers from Wanluan and beyond passed through, later known for furniture makers. Shophouses keep the long shop-in-front, warehouse-behind layout, and a century-old red-brick alley so narrow it was named 'Breast-Touching Alley' in 2010. Residents now run events like the Spring Tide market to revive it.
getting_there: 台鐵潮州站步行約10分鐘
best_time: 春潮集等活動期間

tagline_zh: 清代大港老街，吃完肉粿去拜王爺
tagline_en: Qing-era port street of fish-cake snacks and the Wangye temple
story_zh: 東港古稱東津，清代設下淡水巡檢司，光緒年間成為屏東平原的出入港口，延平老街一帶是貨物集散地。日治時期東港為特別輸出入港，街上留有巴洛克式與日式建築，但因天災頻繁，百年建築不多。東隆宮溫王爺的迎王平安祭典每三年一次，是全台知名的王船祭。
story_en: Donggang was a Qing port with a sub-prefectural post, and by the late 19th century the gateway for the Pingtung plain, with Yanping Street as its goods hub. In the Japanese era it was a designated trading port; some Baroque and Japanese-style buildings remain, though storms have taken many. The triennial Welcoming the Royal Lord festival at Donglong Temple, ending in a boat burning, is famous across Taiwan.
getting_there: 台鐵屏東站或林邊站轉乘客運至東港站，步行約10分鐘
best_time: 迎王平安祭典期間（每三年一次，秋季）；4–6月黑鮪魚季

address_hint: 三民路、中山路一帶（白沙觀光港附近）
tagline_zh: 上島第一站，麻花捲與海島小吃
tagline_en: First stop on the island: twisted dough snacks and seafood
story_zh: 小琉球老街位於白沙觀光港附近的三民路、中山路一帶，是島上最熱鬧的商街。島民早年以捕魚為生，漁民當點心的「繩仔股」麻花捲因耐放好吃，後來發展成島上最知名的伴手禮。街道多為戰後建築，以伴手禮與小吃為主。
story_en: Xiaoliuqiu's old street lies along Sanmin and Zhongshan roads near Baisha harbour, the island's busiest shopping strip. Islanders lived by fishing, and the twisted dough snack fishermen took to sea keeps well, so it became the island's signature souvenir. Buildings are mostly post-war; it is all about snacks and gifts.
getting_there: 東港搭渡輪至白沙港，步行即達
best_time: 夏季遊客多，晚上部分店家營業

address_hint: 佳冬村溝渚路、佳興路一帶
tagline_zh: 客家五堂大屋與抗日步月樓
tagline_en: Five-hall Hakka mansion and an anti-Japanese gate tower
story_zh: 佳冬是六堆的左堆，保存台灣少見完整的客家建築群。蕭家古厝是罕見的五堂大屋，蕭家書房兼出城門樓「步月樓」在1895年乙未戰爭時是蕭光明率鄉勇抗日的戰場。張家商樓是佳冬唯一的雙層紅磚商樓，楊氏宗祠則以前庭太極池聞名。
story_en: Jiadong, the Left Camp of the Liudui Hakka, keeps an unusually complete set of Hakka buildings. The Xiao family mansion has a rare five-hall layout, and its gate tower Buyue Lou was where Xiao Guangming led militia against Japanese troops in 1895. The Zhang family shop is the town's only two-storey red-brick shophouse, and the Yang ancestral hall is known for its yin-yang pond.
getting_there: 台鐵佳冬站步行約10分鐘
best_time: 蕭家古厝開放時段需事先確認

tagline_zh: 全台最大土地公廟前喝綠豆蒜
tagline_en: Mung-bean soup by Taiwan's biggest Earth God temple
story_zh: 車城舊稱柴城，是恆春半島最早的漢人聚落之一，1867年羅妹號事件後，台灣總兵劉明燈率兵進駐，福安宮碑記記錄了與美國領事李仙得締結南岬之盟的事蹟。福安宮號稱全台最大土地公廟，廟口周邊以綠豆蒜聞名。道路拓寬後舊建築已不多。
story_en: Checheng, once Chaicheng, was one of the earliest Han settlements on the Hengchun Peninsula. After the 1867 Rover incident, Qing general Liu Mingdeng garrisoned troops here, and a stele at Fu'an Temple records the treaty with US consul Le Gendre. Fu'an claims to be Taiwan's largest Earth God temple and the streets around it are known for mung bean soup. Road widening has left few old buildings.
getting_there: 高雄搭國光客運或墾丁快線至車城站
best_time: 往墾丁途中順道停留

address_hint: 溫泉村文化路、溫泉公園一帶
tagline_zh: 日治四大名湯之一的溫泉小街
tagline_en: Small spa street of one of the Japanese era's four great hot springs
story_zh: 四重溪溫泉於日治初期開發，1930年前後已有公共浴場與多間溫泉旅社，與北投、陽明山、關子嶺並稱四大溫泉。現存清泉日式溫泉館前身為山口旅館，相傳1930年代日本皇族曾來此度蜜月。如今溫泉街規模不大，溫泉公園設有免費泡腳池。
story_en: Sichongxi's springs were developed early in the Japanese era, and by around 1930 there were public baths and several inns; it was counted among Taiwan's four great hot springs. The Qingquan Japanese-style spa was once the Yamaguchi inn, where a Japanese prince reputedly honeymooned in the 1930s. The spa street is small today, and the hot spring park has a free foot bath.
getting_there: 國光客運至車城站轉乘屏東客運往四重溪；建議開車
best_time: 冬季泡湯最適合

address_hint: 中山路、光明路一帶（恆春古城內）
tagline_zh: 海角七號拍攝地，城門內的老街
tagline_en: Old town inside Hengchun's walls, star of 'Cape No. 7'
story_zh: 恆春舊稱瑯嶠，1874年牡丹社事件後，沈葆楨奏請設恆春縣並築城，恆春古城是台灣保存最完整的清代城池之一。城內中山路一帶為老街，2008年電影《海角七號》在此取景，「阿嘉的家」吸引大量影迷。老街以小吃、恆春洋蔥及往來墾丁的遊客為主。
story_en: Hengchun, once Langqiao, got its county and walls after the 1874 Mudan incident at the request of Shen Baozhen; its walls are among Taiwan's best-preserved Qing fortifications. The old street lies around Zhongshan Road inside the walls, and the 2008 film 'Cape No. 7' was shot here, with 'Aga's house' drawing fans. Today it serves snacks, local onions and visitors heading to Kenting.
getting_there: 高雄搭國光客運或墾丁快線至恆春轉運站，步行約5分鐘
best_time: 傍晚至夜間較熱鬧；元宵節搶孤

image.commons_file: 恒春老街 - Hengchun Old Street - 2012.02 - panoramio.jpg

tagline_zh: 南橫入口的芋頭冰一條街
tagline_en: Taro ice street at the gateway to the Southern Cross-Island Highway
story_zh: 甲仙位於楠梓仙溪畔，是南橫公路西段入口，日治時期因樟腦業興起。當地盛產檳榔心芋，文化路上芋冰城林立，芋頭冰與芋餅成為最有名的特產。老建築不多，以美食與伴手禮為主，適合往返南橫或寶來時順道停留。
story_en: Jiaxian sits on the Nanzixian River at the western entrance to the Southern Cross-Island Highway and grew with the camphor industry in the Japanese era. It is famous for taro, and Wenhua Road is lined with taro-ice shops selling ice and taro pastries. There are few old buildings; it is a food and souvenir stop on the way to the mountains.
getting_there: 建議開車；或高雄客運由旗山轉乘至甲仙
best_time: 夏季吃芋頭冰；假日人多

address_hint: 和平街（南門福德祠至北門福德祠）
tagline_zh: 開蘭第一街，頭圍港貨物集散的六百公尺
tagline_en: 'First Street of Yilan' — a 600 m Qing-era port street of shophouses and old temples
story_zh: 頭城古稱頭圍，是吳沙於1796年率眾入墾蘭陽平原的第一個據點，和平街因而有「開蘭第一街」之稱。街道沿著頭圍港與通往烏石港的港道發展，清代是宜蘭貨物進出的集散中心。1924年大水淤塞港道，加上鐵路取代海運，老街從此沒落，卻也因此留下閩南街屋、洋樓立面與古廟老榕。
story_en: Toucheng (old name Touwei) was the first foothold Wu Sha's settlers built on the Lanyang Plain in 1796, which is why Heping Street calls itself the 'first street of Yilan'. Growing beside Touwei harbour and the channel to Wushi port, it was the region's freight hub in the Qing era. A 1924 flood silted up the harbour and the railway took over trade, so the street declined — leaving its Minnan shophouses, Western-style facades, temples and old banyans largely in place.
getting_there: 台鐵頭城站步行約5分鐘
best_time: 農曆七月底「頭城搶孤」期間最熱鬧；平日安靜適合散步

address_hint: 大里里濱海公路（台2線）旁、慶雲宮一帶
tagline_zh: 草嶺古道口的海邊小村，石頭厝與天公廟
tagline_en: A seaside hamlet at the foot of the Caoling Historic Trail, with stone houses and a Jade Emperor temple
story_zh: 大里位於草嶺古道的宜蘭端出入口，清代往來淡水與噶瑪蘭的旅人在此歇腳，聚落一度熱鬧。相傳旅人出發翻山前，會撿一顆圓石到大里天公廟過爐作為護身符。如今只剩沿海岸線的小漁村，街上仍可見零星石頭厝與老榕。
story_en: Dali sits at the Yilan end of the Caoling Historic Trail, where Qing-era travellers between Tamsui and Kavalan rested before or after crossing the mountains. Legend says walkers picked up a round pebble and passed it over the incense burner at the Dali Jade Emperor Temple as a protective charm. Today it is a small fishing village strung along the coast road, with a few stone houses and old banyans left.
getting_there: 台鐵大里站下車即達
best_time: 可與草嶺古道健行（秋季芒花季）合併安排

address_hint: 利澤村利澤路（利生醫院至永安宮）
tagline_zh: 噶瑪蘭「休息地」，元宵走尪的河港老街
tagline_en: A Kavalan 'resting place' turned river port, famous for its Lantern Festival god-running
story_zh: 「利澤簡」源自噶瑪蘭舊社地名，意為「休息地」。清代靠著冬山河的港口地利成為貨物集散地，還設有「利澤簡堡」，後因陸運興起而沒落，地名也簡化為「利澤」。每年元宵節的「走尪」，壯丁抬神轎從街頭的利生醫院一路奔跑到街尾永安宮，是宜蘭獨特的民俗。
story_en: The name Lizejian comes from a Kavalan village name meaning 'resting place'. In the Qing era its landing on the Dongshan River made it a freight hub and an administrative seat, but overland transport later drained its trade and the name was shortened to Lize. Every Lantern Festival, young men carry palanquins at a run from the 1920 Lisheng Clinic at one end of the street to Yong'an Temple at the other in the 'running gods' ritual.
getting_there: 建議開車，或自羅東轉乘公車
best_time: 元宵節「走尪」活動

image.commons_file: 利澤簡永安宮-2013年利澤簡走尪活動.jpg

address_hint: 冬山車站周邊、中正路一帶
tagline_zh: 社區用老照片門牌說故事的小鎮街道
tagline_en: A small-town main street telling its past through old-photo doorplates
story_zh: 冬山老街是冬山鄉舊市街，商圈協會近年加裝燈飾、街頭彩繪，並把鄉內老照片做成店家門牌，掃QR code就能看到店家介紹。其中一張舊照記錄早年冬山常淹水、居民搭船娶親的景象。街區以日常商店為主，適合順路散步。
story_en: Dongshan's old main street is a working small-town commercial strip. The local business association has added lighting, murals and doorplates printed with historic photos of the township, with QR codes linking to each shop's story. One photo shows a wedding party travelling by boat during the floods that once plagued the area. It's an everyday street best enjoyed as a short stroll.
getting_there: 台鐵冬山站步行可達

landmarks: 新城天主堂（新城神社遺址鳥居）
tagline_zh: 淘金熱留下的小街，老照相館與神社鳥居
tagline_en: A gold-rush-era main street near Taroko, with an old photo studio and a shrine gate
story_zh: 新城博愛路一帶早年因立霧溪淘金熱而繁華，礦業退燒與台9線改道後逐漸沒落。街上的新城照相館是日治時期就開業的老店，近年因道路拓寬計畫面臨拆除爭議。附近的新城天主堂建在新城神社遺址上，日式鳥居仍保留在入口。
story_en: Boai Road in Xincheng boomed during the Liwu River gold rush, then faded as mining ended and Highway 9 was rerouted. Its Xincheng Photo Studio dates from the Japanese era and has recently been at the centre of a debate over road widening. Nearby, Xincheng Catholic Church stands on the site of a Shinto shrine, with the torii gate still at its entrance.
getting_there: 台鐵新城（太魯閣）站步行約10分鐘
best_time: 可與太魯閣行程順遊

tagline_zh: 太魯閣族部落裡的手工鍛刀街
tagline_en: A Truku village where blacksmiths still hand-forge mountain knives
story_zh: 銅門村位於木瓜溪畔、中央山脈山腳，是台灣少數擁有成熟製刀技術的原住民部落。當地鐵鋪以手工鍛打山刀聞名，融合太魯閣族的用刀智慧，部分鐵鋪已傳承數代。所謂「老街」其實是幾家打鐵店聚集的部落道路，而非傳統街屋群。
story_en: Tongmen, on the Mugua River at the foot of the Central Range, is one of the few Indigenous villages in Taiwan with an established blade-forging tradition. Its smithies hand-forge mountain knives shaped by Truku know-how, some run by the same family for generations. The 'old street' is really a village road with a handful of forges rather than a row of historic shophouses.
getting_there: 建議開車，花蓮市區約30分鐘
best_time: 可與慕谷慕魚（需申請）行程結合

address_hint: 中正路、中山路一帶舊市街
tagline_zh: 日治關山郡治所在，棋盤街區的縱谷小鎮
tagline_en: A grid-plan valley town that was a Japanese-era district seat
story_zh: 關山舊名「里壠」，源自阿美語，指當地多恙蟲。日治時期1915年設里壠支廳，1937年改為關山郡，是池上、鹿野、海端等地的行政核心，並因製糖、樟腦與木材業吸引移民，形成棋盤式街道。今天舊車站、鐵道宿舍與嘉賓旅社等老建築散落其間，部分官舍已殘破。
story_en: Guanshan was once called Lilong, from an Amis word referring to the chiggers common here. Under Japanese rule it became a sub-prefecture seat in 1915 and the Guanshan district capital in 1937, drawing settlers for sugar, camphor and timber and laid out on a grid. The old station, railway dormitories and the Jiabin Hotel remain among newer buildings, though some official residences are in ruins.
getting_there: 台鐵關山站步行可達
best_time: 可搭配關山環鎮自行車道

tagline_zh: 溫泉飯店林立的龍泉路，入夜像小夜市
tagline_en: The hot-spring resort strip of Longquan Road, a mini night market after dark
story_zh: 知本溫泉是卑南族知本部落傳統領域，日治時期開始被開發為溫泉地，戰後發展成台東最知名的溫泉區。龍泉路沿線溫泉旅館、小吃店與紀念品店林立，入夜後攤商聚集，像一座小型夜市。這裡的「老街」指溫泉商圈，幾乎沒有歷史建築。
story_en: Zhiben's springs lie in the traditional territory of the Puyuma Katratripulr community and were developed as a spa under Japanese rule, growing into Taitung's best-known hot-spring resort after the war. Longquan Road is lined with spa hotels, snack shops and souvenir stores, and stalls gather after dark like a small night market. The 'old street' is a resort strip rather than a historic district, with almost no old buildings.
getting_there: 台鐵知本站轉乘公車約20分鐘
best_time: 冬季泡湯季、晚上逛街

tagline_zh: 南迴伐木年代的熱鬧街，如今靜靜靠著太平洋
tagline_en: A South-Link town street that boomed with loggers, now quiet by the Pacific
story_zh: 大武位於南迴東西交通的入口，1960年代伐木工人眾多，老街曾有多家旅社、南台東最大的戲院、碾米廠與魚苗批發。伐木業式微、台9線開通後人潮不再，不少老屋殘破或無人居住。社區近年推動散步路線，講述楊家碾米廠與瑞士修女的故事。
story_en: Dawu sits where the South-Link route reaches the east coast. In the 1960s loggers filled its old street, which had several inns, the largest cinema in southern Taitung, a rice mill and fish-fry wholesalers. As logging declined and Highway 9 bypassed the town, trade drained away and many houses now stand empty. The community now runs walking routes telling stories of the Yang family rice mill and Swiss nuns who served here.
getting_there: 台鐵大武站步行可達

tagline_zh: 澎湖第一街，天后宮後的媽宮街內
tagline_en: Penghu's first street, behind Taiwan's oldest Mazu temple
story_zh: 中央街俗稱「街內」，清代澎湖納入版圖後，媽宮港澳初期只駐軍，到乾隆年間天后宮周邊商店才漸成規模，是澎湖最早的商業街。街上仍有四眼井、施公祠、萬軍井等古蹟，房屋以紅磚、木料與咾咕石建成。如今老屋多改為伴手禮與小吃店，是馬公最熱門的散步街區。
story_en: Known locally as 'inside the street', Central Street grew up behind the Penghu Tianhou Temple, Taiwan's oldest Mazu temple, after the Qing took the islands; merchants clustered here from the Qianlong era, making it Penghu's first commercial street. Relics like the Four-Eyed Well, Shi Lang Shrine and Wanjun Well survive among houses built of red brick, timber and coral stone. Today many old houses sell local snacks and souvenirs, making it Magong's favourite stroll.
getting_there: 馬公市區步行可達（距馬公港約5分鐘）
best_time: 傍晚涼爽時；夏季花火節期間人潮多

address_hint: 池西村（舊稱小池角）聚落內
tagline_zh: 西嶼小池角聚落裡的舊街巷
tagline_en: A barely-documented old lane in the Xiaochijiao fishing village on Xiyu
story_zh: 小池角是西嶼鄉池西村的舊稱，為傳統漁村聚落，竹仔街據傳是聚落內舊時的商店街巷。目前公開資料極少，現場多為民居與零星咾咕石老屋，沒有成形的商圈。可與鄰近的小池角雙曲橋、池西岩瀑一起順遊。
story_en: Xiaochijiao is the old name of Chixi village on Xiyu island, a traditional fishing settlement; Zhuzai Street is said to have been its old shopping lane. Very little is documented about it, and today it is mostly homes with a few coral-stone houses and no real shops. It is best treated as a detour from the nearby Xiaochijiao Double-Curved Bridge and Chixi basalt cliffs.
getting_there: 建議騎車或開車，馬公市區約40分鐘

tagline_zh: 澎湖保存最完整的玄武岩與咾咕石聚落
tagline_en: Penghu's best-preserved village of basalt and coral-stone courtyard houses
story_zh: 二崁是以陳姓為主的單姓聚落，傳統合院以玄武岩、咾咕石與紅磚砌成，是澎湖第一個傳統聚落保存區。族人早年遠赴外地經商、行醫致富後回鄉蓋屋，陳氏古厝即是代表。如今村民經營杏仁茶與香草小舖，傳統戲曲「褒歌」也在村中傳唱。
story_en: Erkan is a single-clan village of the Chen family whose courtyard houses are built of basalt, coral stone and red brick; it was Penghu's first designated traditional settlement preservation area. Clan members who made their fortunes as merchants and doctors elsewhere came home to build the grand Chen family houses. Villagers now run small shops selling almond tea and herbal products.
getting_there: 建議騎車或開車，馬公市區約30分鐘
best_time: 早上或傍晚避開烈日

landmarks: 沙美萬安堂起源地紀念公園
tagline_zh: 鹽場興起的八卦街，時光停在數十年前
tagline_en: A salt-trade 'Bagua Street' where time seems to have stopped decades ago
story_zh: 沙美是金門最早形成的市街之一，舊稱「八卦街」，明代金門鹽業興盛，鹽場多集中於此，帶來萬商雲集的景況。戰地時期曾是阿兵哥消費的熱鬧街區，駐軍減少後逐漸沉寂，街景大致保留數十年前的樣貌。近年部分廢屋被彩繪成異國風建築，成為網路拍照點。
story_en: Shamei is one of Kinmen's oldest market towns, nicknamed 'Bagua (Eight Trigrams) Street' for its maze of lanes; it boomed in the Ming dynasty when Kinmen's salt fields clustered here. During the military era it bustled with soldiers on leave, then went quiet as garrisons shrank, leaving its streetscape much as it was decades ago. Some abandoned houses have recently been repainted in Middle Eastern style, drawing photographers.
getting_there: 金門公車至沙美站，或騎車／開車

address_hint: 陽翟大街（金東電影院旁）
tagline_zh: 凍結在戰地年代的阿兵哥街，電影《軍中樂園》場景
tagline_en: A soldiers' street frozen in the Cold War era, set for the film Paradise in Service
story_zh: 陽翟老街在戰地時期是駐軍休假消費的街區，撞球間、冰果室、照相館與金東電影院沿街排開。撤軍後店家相繼歇業，整條街幾乎原樣保留，2014年電影《軍中樂園》即在此取景。現場以懷舊招牌與空屋為主，商業活動很少。
story_en: During Kinmen's front-line years, Yangzhai's street served soldiers on leave with billiard halls, ice shops, photo studios and the Jindong Cinema. After the troops left the shops closed one by one, leaving the street almost untouched, and it served as a set for the 2014 film Paradise in Service. Expect retro signboards and empty storefronts rather than open shops.
getting_there: 建議騎車或開車；可搭金門公車

image.commons_file: 陽翟聚落軍中樂園場景(2).jpg

address_hint: 莒光路、民權路一帶（後浦）
tagline_zh: 後浦城隍廟前的金門美食伴手禮中心
tagline_en: Kinmen's food-and-souvenir heart around the old Houpu town god temple
story_zh: 金城舊稱後浦，清代金門總兵署由舊金城遷到此地後，成為全島政經中心。莒光路一帶老街以城隍廟為中心，周邊有國定古蹟邱良功母節孝坊、總兵署與洋樓。今日街上滿是廣東粥、燒餅、貢糖與砲彈菜刀店，是遊客必訪的金門市區。
story_en: Jincheng was called Houpu; after the Qing moved the Kinmen garrison headquarters here from the old walled town, it became the island's political and commercial centre. The old streets around Juguang Road radiate from the Town God Temple, near the Qiu Liang-gong Mother's Chastity Arch and the restored Garrison Headquarters. Today they are packed with shops selling Cantonese congee, sesame flatbreads, peanut candy and knives forged from artillery shells.
getting_there: 金城車站步行約3分鐘
best_time: 早上吃廣東粥；農曆四月十二日迎城隍最熱鬧

tagline_zh: 明代金門城外的賣菜街，六百年的石板路
tagline_en: A Ming-dynasty market lane outside the old Kinmen walled town
story_zh: 明遺老街位於舊金門城北門外，可追溯至明洪武年間築城時期。城門有出入限制與宵禁，商販便在城外交易，形成「賣菜街」，路寬剛好容手推板車通行。清代政經中心移往後浦後逐漸沒落，2005年登錄為歷史建築，街屋混合明代店屋、閩南合院與戰地防空洞。
story_en: This lane lies outside the north gate of the old Kinmen walled town, built in the early Ming. With gate controls and curfews inside, traders set up outside the walls, creating a vegetable-market street just wide enough for handcarts. When the Qing moved the seat of power to Houpu it declined; it was registered as a historic building in 2005 and mixes Ming-style shophouses, Minnan courtyard homes and military-era air-raid shelters.
getting_there: 建議騎車或開車，距金城市區約10分鐘

tagline_zh: 南洋僑資打造、「足以為模範」的紅磚拱廊街
tagline_en: A 1924 red-brick arcade street built with overseas Chinese money 'to serve as a model'
story_zh: 1924年，金門商會會長傅錫琪與仕紳翁同文遠赴南洋集資，要蓋一條「足以為模範」的街道。T字形街區共40間店屋，前進為日式洋樓紅磚拱廊，後進為閩式建築，融合日本、閩南、西洋與南洋風格。1979年中美斷交時曾改名自強街，數年後才改回原名，現為歷史建築。
story_en: In 1924 Kinmen chamber of commerce head Fu Xi-qi and gentleman Weng Tong-wen raised funds in Southeast Asia to build a street 'worthy of being a model'. Its 40 T-shaped-plan shophouses pair red-brick arcaded Western-Japanese fronts with Minnan rear halls. Renamed 'Self-Strengthening Street' after the US cut ties with Taiwan in 1979, it regained its name a few years later and is now a registered historic building.

tagline_zh: 馬祖聚落保存的起點，曾是牛角的商店街
tagline_en: Where Matsu's village-preservation movement began, once Niujiao's shopping street
story_zh: 牛角聚落以一條已加蓋的小溪分為東西兩區，東側的「大澳」是昔日商店街，居民以曹姓為主，靠漁業與商業維生。1990年代中期起地方推動「長住馬祖與聚落保存」，花崗岩老屋陸續整修為咖啡屋與民宿，風潮再擴及北竿芹壁等地。元宵「擺暝」祭典也是牛角重要的年節活動。
story_en: Niujiao is split by a now-covered stream; the eastern side, Da'ao, was the village's shopping street, home mostly to the Cao clan who lived by fishing and trade. From the mid-1990s local leaders championed 'living in Matsu and preserving its villages', restoring granite houses as cafes and guesthouses — a movement that later spread to Qinbi in Beigan. Lantern Festival 'Baimeng' rites remain a highlight of the village calendar.
getting_there: 南竿公車至牛角站，或騎車
best_time: 元宵擺暝期間
